mechanism: Yggdrasil source-native R3 true episodic transition memory + public-goal bounded search, vs same-source original Yggdrasil R2 and equally informed conventional optimistic online A* (not secretly expert BFS); also preserve Wingless R2 negative via original K4Y records, no need to retrain Wingless in this candidate-specific followup.

worlds.source_minigrid: real original MiniGrid FullyObsWrapper only; native gets existing public position, direction, goal and front blocked and experience-only observed action effects
worlds.fit_curriculum: 7/8 public-BFS teacher + 1/8 uniformly exploratory, same source retained from K4Y (not K4Y environments), 6000 action consequences per family
worlds.dev_adaptation: record actual public action outcomes online to create episodic graph; no DEV reward to update long-term policy weights; online graph data also available to matched conventional comparator; fresh episode graph per heldout world

frozen_primary: R3 must achieve >=4/8 successful goals on genuine fresh FourRooms DEV, improve by >=3 completions over same-source R2, and achieve 75% of public learned-dynamics planner mean reward in FourRooms. It must show real source-owned episodic memory exploration, cold full-state restoration, and no hidden map or source leak. Compare online optimistic planner on same public input and outcome budget; if conventional online planner matches or exceeds native resource-normalized success, do not claim native novelty/Pareto gain. Empty regression not permitted more than 2/8 vs R2.
study_limit: Public development on unchanged MiniGrid two families with different unseen start/goal, NOT unfamiliar task family transfer nor accepted scientific first use, and hand-engineered goal-directed optimistic search is a conventional planning component. Any improvement validates bounded memory and planning integration, not independent discovery of general intelligence.
resource: per-episode entire public action trace, source updates, own graphs and checkpoint SHA/size, wall and Python CPU and peak RSS; no energy or FLOP claims
